summary: G. Willi-Food International Ltd., a kosher foods distributor, filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 earnings press release. The release reports flat sales of NIS 160.5 million ($53.7 million), gross profit up 21.5% to NIS 53.5 million, operating profit up 22.7% to NIS 25.3 million, but net profit down 33.9% to NIS 21.1 million. Management discusses strategic progress, including construction of a new refrigerated logistics center expected operational in Q4 2026. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, activist involvement, or strategic review is mentioned. The company's cash and securities balance stood at NIS 257.6 million ($86.5 million).
